# The census baseline gt-gojo0's budget table is built from, taken at commit
# b4f678ef on 2026-10-30.
#
# Source: the 60 one-minute census windows ending 2026-10-30 12:36 CDT, as the
# hot-path beads quote them (gt-hw6ih, gt-r9pj9, gt-z0dcj, gt-pjcpb, gt-3bqfy).
# A window logs only its eight busiest rows (censusLogRows), so a caller that
# never ranks in a window is never named; over the baseline nine callers were
# named with a rate each, and every caller below them averaged at most the
# ninth's 1.0 a minute, because a faster caller ranks in every window. Rates,
# not call counts: 762 calls over 60 minutes is 12.7 a minute.
#
# Columns: calls per minute, caller, the hot-path bead that cuts it (- when no
# bead does). A budget is the rate times 1.25, rounded up to the next
# hundredth.
